_about: WorkDesk sample board. Deliberately mixes THREE different payload shapes so you can see the adapters work: (1) the documented Field Nation REST v2 work-order shape, (2) WorkMarket-style assignment objects, (3) flat rows like a DOM scrape or CSV export. orders.title: POS terminal refresh — 6 lanes

description.html:
Swap out six defective POS terminals at a grocery location. Units ship to site ahead of you. Scope: unbox, cable, image verify, run test transaction on each lane, photo before/after, recycle old units to the provided pallet.

  • Cat6 to each lane, existing runs are good
  • PIN pads pair over Bluetooth
  • Store closes at 22:00 — work must be after hours

orders.title: Fiber tie-in + OTDR trace — cell site

description.html: Terminate 12-strand single mode in an existing cabinet, run OTDR traces both directions, upload results. Must have own OTDR and fusion splicer. Site is gated, check-in with NOC on arrival.

orders.title: Rack and stack — 4x servers + switch, data hall B

description.html: Rail and stack four 2U servers and one TOR switch in an existing cabinet. Label to provided spreadsheet, cable mgmt to spec, power on, verify link lights, hand off to remote NOC for imaging. Loading dock available, no lift needed.

orders.title: Structured cabling pull — 24 drops, office fit-out

description.html: Pull and terminate 24 Cat6A drops in an open ceiling office space. Patch panel, faceplates, label both ends, certify with Fluke and upload the report. J-hooks already installed, cable on site.

orders.title: Kiosk refresh — 3 self-check-in units, hotel lobby

description.html: Replace three lobby self-check-in kiosks. Disconnect old, mount new, network + power, verify printer and card reader, run a test check-in. Lobby is public-facing so appearance matters: no boxes left out, clean up same shift.

orders.title: Break/fix — label printer down at distribution center

description.html: Zebra ZT411 not feeding labels. Diagnose, clean/replace printhead if the spare on site fits, verify with a 20-label test print. If it needs a part we don't have, document and close as parts-required.

orders.title: Drive-thru menu board swap — 2 displays + media player

description.html: Remove two 49-inch drive-thru displays, install replacements, connect to existing media player, verify content. Lift provided on site. Working at height — harness required.

orders.title: AP / wireless survey — 40 APs, campus refresh

description.html: Walk the campus with the provided Ekahau rig, capture AP locations and signal, photograph mounting locations for the refresh bid. No installation on this scope — survey and photo documentation only. Report template supplied.

orders.title: Decommission — 2 full racks, wipe + palletize

description.html: Decommission two racks: label, unmount, wipe drives to client standard, palletize and shrink-wrap for carrier pickup. Manifest must match asset tags exactly. Two techs requested; rate is per tech.

orders.title: CCTV camera add — 6 domes, warehouse perimeter

description.html: Mount six IP domes on an existing warehouse perimeter, home-run to the NVR closet, PoE test, aim and focus each with the client on site, label the patch panel. Conduit and cable are roughed in.

orders.title: Site survey — retail build-out, photos + measurements
orders.description: Walk the space, photograph all four walls of each room, capture ceiling height, note electrical panel location and available circuits, measure for the cabling bid. Upload to the assignment with the checklist.

orders.title: Handheld scanner deployment — 120 units
orders.description: Image, label and stage 120 rugged handhelds for a distribution rollout. Work from the supplied asset list, scan each into the client's MDM, box and palletize by store. Two-day assignment.

orders.title: ATM swap — lobby unit, credit union branch
orders.description: Remove an end-of-life ATM, install the replacement on the existing plinth, reconnect network and power, verify with the branch manager, haul the old unit to the designated room. No cash handling.

orders.title: Structured cabling audit + remediation — 3 floors
orders.description: Audit an existing Cat5e plant, certify each drop, re-terminate failures, dress and label both patch panels, deliver a spreadsheet of pass/fail per drop. Materials provided.

orders.title: Tablet refresh — 40 units, school district
orders.description: Collect 40 old tablets, deploy 40 new ones from the staged cart, verify each enrolls, hand off charging carts. Work must happen outside class hours.

orders.title: EV charger install — 4 L2 units, fleet yard
orders.description: Mount four Level 2 chargers on existing conduit runs, land conductors, torque to spec, commission each with the app, photograph the finished install and the nameplate.

orders.title: Store reset — planogram, 14 bays
orders.description: Overnight reset of 14 bays to a new planogram. Move product, replace shelf strips, apply new signage, photograph each finished bay. Non-technical.

orders.title: Network closet cleanup + documentation
orders.description: Untangle and dress two closets, label every patch, produce a port map. No new cabling.
